end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified fourteen as one bundle and four loose sticks after prompting.
They repeated that the 1 in fourteen refers to one bundle of ten.
When counting all, they counted the bundle as one stick; this mix-up remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making numbers 11–20 with one bundle of ten and loose sticks. Saanvi used the bundle-and-loose-ones method to describe 14, but counted the bundle as one stick when finding the total. At home, build numbers with ten grouped objects and ask, “How many in the bundle, and how many loose?”
